tables.name: messages
tables.label: Messages
tables.description: One row per chat message: who sent it, the original text, its translation, and the sender's language.

tables.name: participants
tables.label: Participants
tables.description: One row per person in the room (keyed by their device id): the language they read and write in. Synced so each device knows what language to translate the other person's messages into.

tables.name: phrases
tables.label: Phrases
tables.description: One row per phrase saved from chat (via the message's "Save phrase" swipe action): the original text, its translation, and both languages, for the Learn screen's phrasebook + practice cards. Also carries spaced-repetition scheduling state (dueAt/intervalDays/reps, updated by the practice cards' "Got it"/"Again" swipe actions; dueAt is also pulled slightly earlier when you open a card's origin peek, at most once an hour, recorded in lastPeekedAt) plus a few reconciler-derived columns (due/dueRank/reviewedToday) that drive the due-only practice queue and stats.
